modes.INSTALL_ATTEMPT: Can run when package com.noodlecake.drtc is absent; records package-manager/install errors while user initiates installation manually.
modes.START_BUTTON: Requires the package to be installed; captures app/native/Deathforth/integrity errors after user taps Start once.

limitations: No Windows PowerShell runtime or Android/ADB device available in current environment; no live install or Start tap tested.
No APK is installed or uninstalled automatically; no save is changed and no signature/licensing bypass is attempted.
Runtime installation, Start behavior, gameplay, UI fit, save/load and stability remain unverified.
next_gate: Run mode 1 for a failed install when package is absent, or mode 2 when installed and Start is unresponsive; review the generated trace ZIP.
